evolution.weakness_hypothesis: The current #1 is not Pareto-best across the three independently scored kernels: live public results place the best observed QKV, attention and FFN cycle counts on different teams, so a MOME portfolio can evolve each legal kernel independently and combine Tao-owned champions into a stronger geometric-mean submission.

canary.promotion_rule: PROMOTE only after the official baseline builds and passes correctness, Arena authentication works, and at least one legal mutation improves its target kernel cycle count by >=1% without failing tolerance checks.

probability.basis: The live official API shows rank 1 at 8.03038x and rank 2 at 7.88485x, only about a 1.85% score gap. The observed per-kernel frontier is split across multiple teams, which supports legal multi-objective headroom, but setup/auth and unfamiliar RNGD tooling remain real uncertainty.
